s.en: show / manipulate DCB (Data Center Bridging) settings

syn: dcb [ OPTIONS ] { app | buffer | ets | maxrate | pfc } { COMMAND | help } ⏎ dcb [ -force ] -batch filename ⏎ dcb [ OPTIONS ] help

o.en: Switches dcb to the specified network namespace NETNS.
Print the version of the dcb utility and exit.
Read commands from provided file or standard input and invoke them. The first failure will cause termination of dcb.
Don't terminate dcb on errors in batch mode. If there were any errors during execution of the commands, the application return code will be non zero.
When showing rates, use ISO/IEC 1024-based prefixes (Ki, Mi, Bi) instead of the 1000-based ones (K, M, B).
If the subtool in question translates numbers to symbolic names in some way, suppress this translation.
When combined with -j generate a pretty JSON output.
If the object in question contains any statistical counters, show them as part of the "show" output.
